tags.name: Dev feature
tags.description: Endpoints for features still under development. They are only served when dev features are enabled and may change or disappear without notice.

post.description: Mint an opaque, single-use token that names the user a client already identified on its own screen. Pass it back as the `login_hint_token` authorization parameter: Katra then asks only for the password and shows a masked confirmation, so the raw identifier never travels in the URL. Machine-to-machine only. The token expires in 10 minutes, is bound to one application, and is consumed by the first successful password verification.
